author: sbutnari
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked into another target in ov_generate_plugins_hpp

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_android
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status failure due to Build arm64 failure

key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into
  another target.
  Call Stack:
    cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:325 (ov_target_link_plugins)
    cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp)
    CMakeLists.txt:196 (include)
root_cause: The Android CMake build fails because plugins (e.g., openvino_intel_gpu_plugin) are built as MODULE_LIBRARY targets, but ov_generate_plugins_hpp/ov_target_link_plugins in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 attempts to link them into another target, which CMake forbids. This is a pre-existing infrastructure/configuration bug in the Android build unrelated to PR #37401 (which only changes src/plugins/intel_npu/tests/driver_version.json). The pattern has been recurring since 2026-08-08. The run is on attempt 2, meaning an automated re-run was already triggered.
reproduction_steps: Build OpenVINO for Android ARM64 with ENABLE_INTEL_GPU=ON and ENABLE_INTEL_CPU=ON targeting the arm64-v8a ABI; the CMake configure step will fail with the MODULE_LIBRARY link error.
recommended_actions: Check whether the fix for the MODULE_LIBRARY plugin link issue has been merged; see related investigation records from 2026-08-08 through 2026-08-10.
If not fixed, the Android arm64 build is blocked by this pre-existing CMake configuration issue unrelated to PR changes.
PR #37401 (NPU driver version update) can be merged once the underlying Android build issue is resolved.
prevention_strategies: Fix the ov_generate_plugins_hpp/ov_target_link_plugins CMake logic in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake to not link MODULE_LIBRARY targets; or adjust the Android build to use SHARED_LIBRARY for plugin targets.
historical_context: This exact error has been recorded 18 times since 2026-08-08 across multiple PRs. It is a known pre-existing bug in the Android CMake configuration, not caused by individual PRs.
